Healthy adult randomized crossover of Sailuotong containing saffron plus ginseng and ginkgo; cognitive effects cannot be attributed to saffron alone.

Extracellular vesicle carrier mechanical properties and crocin in cancer model; no Parkinson muscle rigidity or saffron food exposure.
Injected crocin in malathion-exposed rats tested motor deficits and catalepsy, not dietary ground saffron or measured Parkinson rigidity.
Saffron pilot measures penile erectile rigidity, a different outcome from Parkinson muscle rigidity.

Salmon leukocyte neuropeptide immunology, not human salmon intake or anxiety outcome.
